title.zh: 谷歌开源Harness²：让AI自己改进工具链，GLM-5跑分提高11.5分
title.en: 谷歌开源Harness²：让AI自己改进工具链，GLM-5跑分提高11.5分

current_state.zh: Google Research released Harness², an open-source (Apache 2.0) agent harness that autonomously rewrites prompts, memory, skills, tool rules and plugins by proposing, A/B-testing and combining agent variants, lifting GLM-5 from 64.2 to 75.7 on WorkBuddy-Bench after a single optimization round.
current_state.en: Google Research released Harness², an open-source (Apache 2.0) agent harness that autonomously rewrites prompts, memory, skills, tool rules and plugins by proposing, A/B-testing and combining agent variants, lifting GLM-5 from 64.2 to 75.7 on WorkBuddy-Bench after a single optimization round.
